name: Skillet hash
intro: The week's leftovers, crisped in one pan with an egg cracked on top. It's a different dinner made from things you've already cooked.
season_anchor: Sweet potato or kabocha, cubed — raw or leftover
season_options: Leftover sausage or pork tenderloin, sliced

variations.context: The default. Sliced sausage crisped with everything, ajvar at the table.
Leftover pork in for the last minute, dates and feta on top.
Two eggs instead of one, chile-garlic oil over the top.

finish: Heat a heavy skillet with a good film of olive oil. Add the cubed squash or sweet potato in one layer and leave it alone until the bottom browns, about five minutes — the same hands-off rule as the fish. Stir, add the pepper and any leftover meat, and cook until everything is crisp at the edges. Make a hollow, crack in an egg, cover the pan for two or three minutes until the white sets.
